newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB has no comment on Advanta buy report.
newsitem.headline: NAB has no comment on Advanta buy report.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd, Australia's largest and most profitable bank, said on Wednesday it would not comment on a newspaper report which said it was considering the acquisition of U.S. credit card group Advanta Corp.
"We don't comment on matters of strategy, particularly on acquisitions and mergers," NAB spokesman Haydn Park told Reuters.
The Australian Financial Review newspaper reported that Melbourne-based NAB was one of several interested parties to obtain information documents on Advanta with a view to an acquisition.

Advanta, which recorded a surprise first quarter loss recently and was then downgraded by ratings agency Standard and Poor's, had asked investment banks "to explore strategic options and possible mergers," the newspaper said.
"It is believed formal expressions of interest in Advanta are being taken now with a view to a sale later this year if other options do not emerge," it said.
One unnamed analyst told the newspaper an Advanta buy would make a lot of sense for NAB, which already owns a banking subsidiary in Michigan.
"It gives them the credit card exposure they are after, it's a neat fit and it's a distressed operation -- the classic NAB scenario," the analyst said.
